observation.visible_scene: A dance studio with light wood flooring, a floor-to-ceiling mirror wall on the left, teal draped curtains, a ballet barre, potted plants, a standing fan and two lighting stands on the right, and a wall logo. A barefoot woman in an olive tank top and black pants is positioned right-of-center, bent forward in a low squat, her right arm extended straight down with fingertips near the floor and her left arm tucked behind her back; her mirrored reflection appears on the left.
visible_changes: The camera gradually reframes (slow zoom-out / slight pan) across the segment: background elements (mirror seams, curtains, fan, light stands, logo) shift position and the visible floor area grows, indicating camera motion rather than object motion.

The dancer holds a sustained low forward-bent posture throughout; only small positional adjustments are visible, with her torso/reaching hand shifting slightly relative to the floor between the first and last frames.
Gray patches on the floor near her hand and feet (consistent with shadows) move in-frame in step with the camera reframing and her minor body shifts.
The mirror reflection tracks the same pose continuously, its position within the mirror changing only because of the camera movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: What precedes or follows this held posture (e.g., whether she stands, transitions, or resumes movement).
The intent or next step of the exercise, which is not shown within the cropped segment.
uncertain_details: Whether the right fingertips actually touch the floor or hover just above it.
Whether the gray floor shapes are shadows or separate objects.
The exact nature of the camera motion (zoom vs. dolly/pan) and how much of the dancer's apparent vertical shift is body movement versus camera reframing.
Whether the dancer is actively moving or essentially static during the excerpt.
